title: NMRNet · 核磁化学位移预测
question: 使用 SE(3) Transformer 建模三维原子局域环境，并采用预训练 + 微调，让同一套深度学习框架处理液态与固态 NMR 化学位移预测，解决不同体系之间结构—谱学关系难以统一建模和比较的问题。
questionEn: NMRNet uses an SE(3) Transformer to model 3D local atomic environments with pretraining and fine-tuning, aiming to predict both liquid- and solid-state NMR chemical shifts in one framework and make structure–spectrum modeling comparable across diverse chemical systems.
summary: NMRNet 使用 SE(3) Transformer 建模原子环境，并采用预训练 + 微调范式；工作同时整理了覆盖多类化学体系的 NMR benchmark。
summaryEn: NMRNet models atomic environments with an SE(3) Transformer using a pretraining-and-fine-tuning paradigm, together with a benchmark spanning diverse NMR datasets.
meaning: 把 3D 几何、等变建模和真实谱学任务连起来，是“representation → model → spectroscopy”最直接的案例之一。
meaningEn: A direct example connecting 3D geometry, equivariant modeling, and a real spectroscopy task.

title: 电解液通用机器学习势 · uMLP / OP-Elyte
titleEn: Universal ML potential for battery electrolytes
question: 使用 DeepPot-SE 机器学习势和并发学习流程反复进行训练、探索、筛选与 DFT 标注，构建面向广泛电解液化学空间的 uMLP，用更低成本驱动长时间尺度 MLMD，并从轨迹计算密度、溶剂化结构、黏度和离子电导率等关键性质。
questionEn: The work uses DeepPot-SE machine-learning potentials with concurrent learning cycles of training, exploration, screening, and DFT labeling to build a domain-oriented uMLP for broad electrolyte chemical space, enabling lower-cost long-timescale MLMD and trajectory-based calculations of density, solvation, viscosity, ionic conductivity, and related properties.
summary: 工作使用随机组合电解液与并行/迭代式数据生成策略构建训练集，以机器学习势驱动 MLMD，并用于密度、溶剂化结构、黏度、电导率等性质分析。
summaryEn: The work builds training data through randomized electrolyte compositions and iterative learning, then uses the ML potential for MLMD studies of density, solvation, viscosity, conductivity and related properties.
meaning: 展示 AI 不只是做一个静态 property predictor，还可以成为高精度模拟的加速器。
meaningEn: Shows that AI can accelerate high-fidelity simulation, not only static property prediction.

title: Cat-KG + LLM · 接力催化路径推荐
question: 先用 LLM 辅助从催化文献中抽取结构化反应信息并构建 Cat-KG，再通过知识图谱查询与催化专家规则筛选、排序多步路径，最后由 LLM 整理为可读结果；解决从海量文献中快速发现接力催化路线，同时保持反应条件和来源可追溯的问题。
questionEn: The workflow uses LLM-assisted extraction to build Cat-KG from catalysis literature, then combines graph queries with catalysis-informed scoring rules to filter and rank multistep pathways before an LLM renders readable results, addressing rapid relay-catalysis pathway discovery while keeping reaction conditions and sources traceable.
summary: LLM 辅助从文献中提取反应数据，构建 Cat-KG；图查询产生候选路径，化学规则负责筛选和排序，LLM 再把结构化结果转成化学家可读的表达。
summaryEn: LLMs assist reaction-data extraction for Cat-KG construction; graph queries produce candidate pathways, chemistry-informed rules rank them, and an LLM renders the structured results for chemists.
meaning: 这是“LLM 不直接拍答案，而是与结构化知识、专家规则结合”的典型科研工作流。
meaningEn: A strong example of combining LLMs with structured knowledge and expert rules rather than asking the LLM to invent the answer directly.

title: NOSE · 分子–受体–气味语义三模态
question: 使用三模态正交对比学习，同时编码并对齐分子结构、嗅觉受体序列和自然语言气味描述，解决嗅觉链路中化学结构、生物受体与人类语义长期被分开建模的问题，并支持嗅觉感知预测、跨模态检索和零样本泛化。
questionEn: NOSE uses tri-modal orthogonal contrastive learning to encode and align molecular structures, olfactory-receptor sequences, and natural-language odor descriptions, addressing the fragmented modeling of chemical structure, biological receptors, and human semantics while supporting olfactory prediction, cross-modal retrieval, and zero-shot generalization.
summary: NOSE 通过三模态正交对比学习对齐分子、受体和语义信息，并在嗅觉感知与零样本检索任务上进行评测。
summaryEn: NOSE aligns molecular, receptor and semantic information through tri-modal orthogonal contrastive learning and evaluates the representation on olfactory perception and zero-shot retrieval tasks.
meaning: 把“multimodal”从一句口号落到具体科学对象：结构、生物受体与人类语言。
meaningEn: Turns multimodality into concrete scientific objects: structure, biological receptors and human language.

title: Uni-XAS · 光谱 ↔ 三维结构双向学习
question: 使用 XASLip 将一维 XAS 光谱与局域三维原子结构对齐到共享空间，并结合检索增强的光谱生成与 Permutation-Rectified Flow Matching 条件三维生成，在同一框架里解决“结构 → 光谱”和“光谱 → 三维结构”两个方向长期分开建模的问题。
questionEn: Uni-XAS uses XASLip to align 1D XAS spectra with local 3D atomic structures in a shared space, then combines retrieval-augmented spectrum generation with Permutation-Rectified Flow Matching for conditional 3D generation, unifying structure-to-spectrum and spectrum-to-structure modeling in one framework.
summary: Uni-XAS 将 XAS 与 3D 结构建模为跨模态对齐和条件生成问题，包含光谱–结构检索、光谱预测和条件 3D 结构生成。
summaryEn: Uni-XAS formulates XAS and 3D structure modeling as cross-modal alignment and conditional generation, covering retrieval, spectrum prediction and conditional 3D structure generation.
meaning: 它把 spectroscopy、3D geometry 和 multimodal learning 串在同一案例里。
meaningEn: Connects spectroscopy, 3D geometry and multimodal learning in one case.

title: 先进封装电子电镀 · 配方研发智能体
question: 把机器学习势、吸附与扩散预测、分子设计、CVS 响应预测等电镀垂域模型与智能体工作流结合，用于先进封装电子电镀添加剂和配方的高通量预测、筛选与实验迭代，减少传统研发对经验试错的依赖。
questionEn: The project combines electroplating specialist models for machine-learning potentials, adsorption and diffusion prediction, molecular design, and CVS response with an agent workflow to support high-throughput prediction, screening, and experimental iteration for advanced-packaging electroplating additives and formulations.
summary: 联合团队构建电镀垂域模型体系，并融合通用模型的任务理解与工作流编排能力，形成面向添加剂与配方研发的智能体，实现预测、筛选、实验验证和模型更新的迭代闭环。
summaryEn: The joint team combines electroplating specialist models with general-model task understanding and workflow orchestration to support an iterative loop of prediction, screening, experimental validation, and model updating for additive and formulation R&D.
meaning: 专业模型负责具体物理化学任务，智能体负责把模型、工具与实验步骤串成可迭代的研发流程。
meaningEn: Specialist models handle specific physical and chemical tasks, while the agent connects models, tools, and experiments into an iterative R&D workflow.
